MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader fit my repeated purchases of removable storage and transfer accessories, provided the card works with my devices; the extra reader is less useful because I already own one.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a practical way to add streaming to my existing television if its connections support it, although I do not need 4K for my 720p set."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and smart plug introduce voice control and home automation when my purchases show practical needs for storage, charging, mounting and power protection.",
    "Buying charging cables does not mean I need USB-C cables: my history shows older connectors, and compatibility determines whether a cable is useful.",
    "Desktop RAM does not serve the same purpose as removable memory cards, and a monitoring camera does not follow from buying photography tripods and lens accessories."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in several Alexa devices, although I have not shown a need for voice control.",
    "Broad similarities such as memory, cameras or car electronics seem to outweigh the specific job each purchase helped me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My accessories need to fit the devices and connectors I already use; a related product is not useful if it requires hardware I have not shown that I own.",
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that support existing equipment, so useful additions matter more to me than starting a new smart-home setup.",
    "What I already own matters: more compatible storage could help, while another reader needs a clear advantage over my current one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and television needs but too often turned practical accessory purchases into assumed interest in Alexa devices and unrelated upgrades."
}
